job.job_description:
Preferred candidate profile :




Hands-on automation engineer with experience building controlled configuration pipelines for network or infrastructure changes.
Should be able to develop reusable templates, manage source-controlled configuration data, enforce validation and quality gates, and support release workflows through CI/CD tooling.
Strong working knowledge of Ansible, Jinja2, YAML, Git and pipeline troubleshooting is expected, with a practical focus on reducing manual build effort, improving config consistency and supporting rollback-safe deployment.




MUST-HAVE:
• Deep Core Transport Project Management Service (Fixed and Mobile) and Technical Delivery Service (Fixed) (Project/Delivery Manager & Coordinator) expertise remains the primary, irreplaceable skill
• AI literacy: what Gemini can and cannot do, hallucination and confidence
• Using AI copilots to draft and cross-check Core Transport – Project Management Service (Fixed and Mobile) and Technical Delivery Service (Fixed) (Project/Delivery Manager & Coordinator) work
• Reviewing and approving agent output with domain judgment (human-in-the-loop)
• No coding required
GOOD-TO-HAVE:
• Google Cloud Generative AI Leader (non-technical)
• Basic prompt patterns for design review




JOB LOCATION: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Chennai
